en: I like spicy food, but I don't want to eat right now.
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan dà là de cài, dànshì wǒ xiànzài bù xiǎng chī.
hanzi: 我喜欢大辣的菜，但是我现在不想吃。

en: I can cook, but I can't cook right now.
pinyin: Wǒ huì zuò fàn, dànshì wǒ xiànzài bù néng zuò fàn.
hanzi: 我会做饭，但是我现在不能做饭。

en: My older sister is at home, and she is reading.
pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zài jiā, tā zài kàn shū.

en: My friend lives in Sarajevo, and I sleep at his house.
pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou zhù zài Sarajevo, wǒ zài tā jiā shuìjiào.
hanzi: 我的朋友住在Sarajevo，我在他家睡觉。
